newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, buying subsides.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, buying subsides.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Friday, ending a strong rally as buying of blue chips Zagrebacka Banka and Pliva subsided.
* Six of 14 issues rose, five fell and three ended flat. Pliva was not traded at all.
* Volume fell to 9,898 from 25,898 units, turnover to 4.7 from 16.8 million kuna.
* Fully-listed Varazdinska Banka ordinary stock was most actively traded. It rose 17 kuna to 239 on volume of 4,648 shares.
* Its preferred second issue shares led gainers, rising 30 kuna or 25 percent to 150 kuna on volume of 150.
* Biggest decliner Arenaturist lost 39 kuna or 23.74 percent to close at 106 kuna with 59 shares sold.
